name: Minimal Edge Dual Contouring Rule
definition: A rule for generating polygons in dual contouring of signed octrees that avoids cracks by only generating polygons on 'minimal edges'. Minimal edges are defined as edges of leaf cubes that do not properly contain an edge of a neighboring leaf.
summary: The Minimal Edge Dual Contouring Rule extracts isosurfaces from simplified signed octrees by generating polygons only on minimal edges, eliminating cracks without extra subdivision.
